# Blog Section

## Blog Section

The Blogs section is helpful to showcase your knowledge and skills by featuring your articles. This section provides visitors with a quick overview of your blog posts.

The simplified design of the blog section is shown below which you created in Chalpter 7.

![Design of the Blog Section](data:image/png;base64,)

Each blog post will be displayed as a card element.

Let's start by creating the card layout.
